surface_mechanism_description: The as-deposited films consist of polysulfide ion clusters and small amounts of tetragonally coordinated MoS2. Upon annealing, these clusters decompose, and the films develop a layered structure. The decomposition involves the transformation of [Mo3S(S2)6]2- clusters into MoS2.
evidence: The as-deposited films were found to consist of polysulfide ion clusters and small amounts of tetragonally coordinated MoS2. Upon annealing, these clusters decomposed, and the films developed a layered structure. The presence of [Mo3S(S2)6]2- clusters was supported by XAS and RMC modeling, indicating their transformation into MoS2 during annealing.
